reuse.why: The existing getScheduledAmount already decides missing/number/range, yet the sites keep their own dispatch and call a new range-only getRangeAmount instead of that helper.

duplication.why: The missing ? 0 : number ? value : range dispatch stays copied at four sites (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule, forecast normalizeSchedule, preview) plus the template's op check, duplicating getScheduledAmount.

placement.why: The new range rule lives in shared/schedules.ts beside getScheduledAmount, which delegates to it.

scope.why: Only the ranged-amount sites, the helper, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: The rule itself is in one function, but the surrounding dispatch is still repeated at each site, so how a schedule amount resolves remains spread out.

bypasses_abstraction.where: schedules/app.ts updateActions and postTransactionForSchedule, forecast-schedules.ts normalizeSchedule and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions keep inline dispatch around getRangeAmount instead of calling getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: The remaining dispatch ternaries are the pre-existing copies left in place, not reshaped.

one_place.where: getRangeAmount in shared/schedules.ts; every path that resolves a ranged amount (the four server sites, schedule-template and getScheduledAmount for client callers) now calls it.
